stories.title: Russia releases former US Marine reported in poor health
stories.summary: Robert Gilman, who was arrested in 2022 for kicking a police officer while drunk, had reportedly been in a catatonic-like state.
stories.post: 📰 NEWS: Russia releases former US Marine reported in poor health. Robert Gilman, who was arrested in 2022 for kicking a police officer while drunk, had reportedly been in a catatonic-like state. Source: BBC World.
article_sentences: Russia has released a former US Marine who was jailed in 2022 and was reportedly in extremely poor health.

Robert Gilman, from Massachusetts, was freed "from detention for humanitarian reasons" and flying on a US plane to Washington, DC, on Tuesday, according to Kirill Dmitriev, special envoy for Russian President Vladimir Putin.
Massachusetts Senator Ed Markey posted on social media that Gilman had been "essentially catatonic" and battling a "severe case of pneumonia" before he was released.
Gilman was 28 when he was arrested for kicking a police officer while drunk aboard a train to Moscow.
